title: needs-review: unknown publication date for proposed doc 'Risk Report: February 2026 (Redacted)'
body:
URL: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/08eca2757081e850ed2ad490e5253e940240ca4f.pdf
No publication date could be determined; scope floor is 2026-01-01.

Justification: Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy risk report for February 2026, linked from anthropic.com and covering Claude Opus 4.6; METR published two separate third-party reviews of it (the sabotage section and the automated-R&D section), so it is clearly a substantive safety document. I am deliberately submitting this for review rather than as a row: (a) I could not determine the exact publication day - the cover says only "February 2026", and secondary sources give both February 10 and February 11 for the sabotage-report component; (b) at least two distinct CDN hashes serve a document with this title (08eca275... and 097c63b5...), so the canonical URL is unclear; and (c) doc_type is genuinely ambiguous between addendum and other. A human should pin the date and the canonical copy.
Evidence: https://metr.org/blog/2026-05-08-rd-section-anthropic-risk-report-feb-2026-review/, https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/097c63b5fe7dd8b14866e1f15bb1910ec713658a.pdf
